newsitem.title: USA: Clinton sends condolences to Israel over crash.
newsitem.headline: Clinton sends condolences to Israel over crash.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Tuesday sent a message of condolences to Israel over the mid-air collision of two military helicopters in which at least 70 soldiers died.

"The President sent a message to Prime Minister (Benjamin) Netanyahu extending, on behalf of all Americans, sincere condolences to the families of the victims and the people and government of Israel," a White House statement said.
"Our nation's thoughts and prayers are with the Israeli people as they grieve the loss of their dedicated service personnel," the statement said.
The night-time collision of the two Sikorsky CH-53 transporters in northern Israel on their way to southern Lebanon was the worst military aviation disaster in the nearly 50 years of Israeli history.
